name: Sysco
description: Sysco is the largest US foodservice distributor: it buys food and supplies from thousands of suppliers and delivers them from its warehouses to restaurants, hospitals, schools, hotels and caterers, mainly in North America and Europe. It earns a gross margin on each case sold (growth comes from inflation, case volume and acquisitions), and runs a dedicated unit for restaurant chains (SYGMA) and a hotel-supply unit. Sysco estimates it serves about 18 percent of a roughly $377B US foodservice market. In March 2026 it agreed to buy Jetro Restaurant Depot (167 cash-and-carry warehouse stores) for about $29.1B in cash and stock.

sub.name: Restaurants, food delivery and foodservice supply

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01); that list does not show industry group or industry.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; Wikipedia S&P 500 list

businessLines.name: U.S. Foodservice Operations
businessLines.how: Resells food and supplies to independent restaurants and other foodservice customers at a markup per case; profit depends on case volume, inflation pass-through, Sysco-brand mix and delivery cost.
businessLines.description: US Broadline (full line of food and non-food products for restaurants and other venues) plus specialty meat, seafood, Italian, Asian specialty and equipment businesses (Buckhead, Newport Meat & Seafood, Greco & Sons, Edward Don).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income before Global Support Center costs; share is of the four operating segments' $4,105M; vs $3,516M FY2025

businessLines.name: International Foodservice Operations
businessLines.how: Same distribution markup model outside the US; lower margin (2.9 percent), with growth helped by inflation, currency and acquisitions.
businessLines.description: Operations outside the US (Canada, the Bahamas, Europe and others per the 10-K).

businessLines.name: SYGMA
businessLines.how: Delivers a chain's full product list to its restaurants on contract, earning a thin per-case or cost-plus margin (1.1 percent of sales).
businessLines.description: US customised distribution to quick-service chain restaurant locations.

businessLines.name: Other (hotel supply, Guest Worldwide)
businessLines.how: Sells amenities and supplies to hotels.

brands.name: Sysco U.S. Broadline
brands.note: Core business inside U.S. Foodservice Operations

brands.name: Buckhead / Newport Meat & Seafood
brands.note: Specialty protein operations (part of U.S. Foodservice; revenue not broken out)

brands.name: Greco & Sons
brands.note: Italian specialty platform (revenue not broken out)

brands.name: Edward Don
brands.note: Restaurant equipment and supplies distribution (revenue not broken out)

whatsNext.text: Acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot (167 stores, 35 states, 725,000+ customers) for about $29.1B ($21.6B cash plus 91.5M shares of new Sysco Holdings); expected to close by the third quarter of fiscal 2027 (roughly December 2026 to March 2027), subject to Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance; JRD holders would own about 16 percent of the combined company
